title: The Kendo Tournament of Love and Mystery
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0916.txt, subs_resolved/0917.txt (839 combined lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Heiji, Kazuha, Officers Takagi/Sato) and the unrelated romance-subplot characters (Momiji, Iori, Onimaru, Namakoshi) omitted by convention as not part of the murder case. case_type: murder. Corrections vs. the old low-fidelity file: (1) murder weapon was wrong -- the old file said a 'sabre' (bladed weapon); the transcript's actual weapon is a single sharpened piece of bamboo (a shinai stave, belonging to the culprit's late son), swung horizontally so centrifugal force opens the throat -- no bladed sword exists anywhere in this episode. (2) The coded 'cutter' clue was misattributed -- the old file's desc implies the killer spoke the line; the transcript makes clear it was the VICTIM Nukitani's own last phone call to his wife asking for a fresh dress shirt ('cutter' = Kansai dialect for dress shirt) after an unrelated nosebleed stained his own shirt, not anything the culprit said or a phrase traceable to them. (3) The old file's stated culprit (Norimura Nenji) is confirmed correct by the transcript. (4) The old file left the motive as 'unspecified'; the real motive is revenge -- Nukitani's biased officiating drove Norimura's son to suicide two years earlier. (5) The old file gave the two other suspects only a generic unspecified motive/knows edge; the transcript grounds each in a real, distinct minor crime (Sadamori secretly laced Nukitani's drink with laxatives after he rejected her; Yokote stalked and secretly photographed Nukitani to embarrass him after being publicly humiliated) -- both are genuine red herrings, not the killer.

attrs.disguise: deliberately wore a stolen student uniform/armor set with the thigh-skirt backwards, to make the fatal blow look like an amateur's lucky strike rather than an expert's
attrs.confession: admits to cutting Nukitani's throat with his dead son's bamboo sword

attrs.secondary_crime: stalked and secretly photographed Nukitani in the bathroom to embarrass him, then deleted the photos after the body was discovered
attrs.grudge: Nukitani had publicly exposed his lie about winning a kendo tournament, in front of his girlfriend at a cafe

attrs.secondary_crime: laced a warm beverage in Nukitani's bag with laxatives out of spite after he rejected her romantic feelings, then retrieved the bottle after finding him dead so it would not be traced to her

objects.name: Plastic bottle of laxative-laced warm beverage

attrs.intent: to inconvenience Nukitani after he rejected her romantic feelings, not to kill him

attrs.anomaly: only the pieces along one edge of the bar were melted, not the whole bar, which body heat alone could not explain

attrs.content: secret photos taken of Nukitani in the bathroom
attrs.fate: deleted by Yokote after the body was discovered

clues.desc: Only the edge of Sadamori's chocolate bar was melted, not the whole thing -- proves a separate warm object, not body heat, was pressed against it, exposing the hidden hot laxative-laced bottle in the same bag.

The phone line the blind witness overheard about a bloody 'cutter' needing replacement was assumed to be the killer arranging a new box cutter, but 'cutter' is Kansai dialect for a dress shirt and the call was actually the victim's own last call to his wife about his nosebleed-stained shirt -- there was never a box cutter at all.

Demonstrated on Yokote, correctly tied thigh-armor shows blood on the front of the skirt; the real bloodstains were on the back/seat, proving whoever wore it -- someone who clearly knew proper technique -- put it on backwards on purpose to fake a novice's mistake.
